source_text.body:
Build a researched monthly social media calendar
A Claude Code skill researches competitors and communities, then generates 20 posts and 4 video reels in a styled Excel file for up to 12 platforms.
·
Apr 1, 2025
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster built a Claude Code skill that first studies a brand’s website and active social channels, then runs live research across Reddit, X, and YouTube, audits the brand’s channels, maps competitors, and produces a narrative brief for approval before generating the calendar. They say it outputs 20 posts and 4 video reels as platform-native content for up to 12 platforms in a styled Excel file, and uses Meta’s API for platform research rather than auto-posting bots.
How it went
The source gives a workflow and one commenter said they tried it and it worked well. It also surfaces a limitation: another commenter noted content like this can still need heavy editing, and the poster did not share performance metrics or business results.
Worth knowing
It is open source and free, but the source says you need Claude Code set up first and use the GitHub repo’s instructions.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build me a monthly social media content calendar for [brand/business] in [industry] for [month]. Research [3-5 competitors] and communities like [subreddits, groups or hashtags] to see what resonates, then create an Excel file with [number] posts and [number] short video reel ideas for [platforms], including caption, format and suggested posting date. Stop when the spreadsheet is saved in this folder and give me a short summary of the themes you chose.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/socialmedia/comments/1sufj17/i_built_a_claude_code_skill_that_generates_a_full
